svg.text: Product Manager at Grove Insurance Holdings | Parent | Always learning

text.tspan: Here is what changed when I started tracking
outcomes, not hours.
I write down wins the same week they happen,
not when I panic later.
Quiet week, useful lesson.
Titles are lagging indicators. Skills are
leading ones.
I renegotiated a recurring task that was
eating my deep-work mornings.
Your reputation is the sum of closed loops.
Saying no to low-leverage work created space
for visible work.
Titles are lagging indicators. Skills are
leading ones.

for visible work.

leading ones.
The people who advance often leave a trail of
clear handoffs.
Documenting your impact is not bragging. It is
translation.
The people who advance often leave a trail of
clear handoffs.
Ask for the assignment that scares you a
little, not the one that flatters you.
I schedule one skill block a week and defend
it like a client call.
